name: Lidice (Czechia)
description: Yellow field with a narrow red border along the hoist and bottom edges, a black thorny branch running diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly, and two red roses with green sepals in the upper hoist and lower fly.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 4 March 2014 (decision No. 11) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.

features.role: border on hoist and bottom edges
